notes.title: 📣 Update – The World of Orathos Temporarily on Hold
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We’d like to inform you that The World of Orathos is currently entering a temporary pause. This decision was made so our team can take a step back and rethink some core elements of the game.

🎮 Reworking the game experience
Your feedback has been invaluable. Many of you have expressed appreciation for the Passive ATB combat system, so we’ll continue developing the game around it. However, we’ve also heard your concerns about the lack of difficulty in some areas and the main storyline feeling too linear — simply moving from point A to point B with limited choice.
We’re now re-evaluating the structure to create a richer, more immersive experience with deeper storylines and meaningful choices.

⚙️ Upcoming changes
Some current mechanics will be removed to make way for ideas we’ve had in mind since the very beginning — ideas that we believe will greatly enhance the game’s vision and quality.

🛠️ Weapons & armor patch
We know many of you are eagerly awaiting the patch for weapons and armor that are currently unavailable. While it’s still on our roadmap, it will now be integrated into the broader redesign of the game.

💡 A necessary break
While development is not canceled, the team needs some time. Our lead developer, Ropana, is currently facing a burnout and is unable to continue working on the project for now.
After a year of intense solo development, this break is crucial for his health and long-term well-being.

🙏 Thank you for your support
We truly appreciate your understanding and continued support. We’ll keep you updated on Ropana’s recovery and the future of Orathos in the coming weeks.

Thank you for being part of the World of Orathos.
This isn’t goodbye — just a much-needed pause to come back stronger.

See you soon,
The World of Orathos Team

notes.title: patch 10.60
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers of Orathos,
Here are the full details of update 10.60, marking an important step forward in the evolution of the game.
[hr][/hr]🎵 Complete Music Overhaul
We’ve reworked and reimplemented all the music tracks throughout the game. This new soundtrack is designed to deepen immersion and enhance the emotional impact of your journey in Orathos.
[hr][/hr]🧝‍♂️ Character Name Changes Incoming
In the coming weeks, all hero and villain names will be gradually replaced with original fantasy-style names.

Why this change?
Originally, the game was a personal project created for friends, and their nicknames were used as characters. Now that the game is publicly available, we’ve decided to respect their privacy and rework the names to better match the lore and tone of a full-fledged fantasy world.
[hr][/hr]📚 Objective 1: Restoring Chapters 8 to 10
We’re actively working on reintegrating Chapters 8, 9, and 10, adapting them to the new combat system introduced in recent patches.

❌ Unfortunately, due to the failure of our Kickstarter campaign, Chapter 11 in its enhanced "2S" version will not be released, despite the work already completed.
[hr][/hr]💻 Objective 2: Moving to a New Graphics Engine
We’re fully aware of RPG Maker MZ's limitations, which is why we’re dedicating this summer to training with a new game engine capable of unlocking Orathos’ full potential.
Whether this leads to an ultimate patch or a fully rebuilt version of the game is still under discussion, but development is moving forward.
[hr][/hr]🔜 What’s Coming Next
Before shifting to the new engine, we aim to release the final updates for this version of the game:

Patch 10.70

Patch 10.80

Patch 10.90

🗓️ These updates are scheduled for release by the end of August 2025, after which regular updates will be paused to focus entirely on the next stage of development.
[hr][/hr]🙏 A Message from the Developer
"I’m not taking a break, even after four years of development.
It’s with mixed emotions that I say goodbye to RPG Maker,
and to the dream of completing Chapter 11 with this engine.
Thank you to everyone who believed in this adventure."
[hr][/hr]💖 Support the Project
If you'd like to support us despite the Kickstarter outcome, you can do so via PayPal donations to:
📩 

erouestrpg@gmail.com


[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support, passion, and feedback.
See you soon in The World of Orathos.

– Ropana, Project Lead

notes.title: Patch 10.20
notes.notes:
A Few Words

This patch required a huge physical effort in terms of concentration. The card system required a lot of coding work. For the first in-game event, located in the Ice Village at the top left of the map, you can find exclusive and unique items.
The Christmas event will run until January 15, 2025.
After that, I will take a small break for now regarding updates. I am struggling to keep up with the progress of the milestone path. The lack of puzzles and motivation is holding me back from continuing with patch 10.
I don't know when patch 10.30 will be released, but what I can tell you is that I will continue the adventure with corrective patches and improvements for my game. However, I will take my time to release a quality update with content.
I will be taking advantage of the winter holidays to recharge and come back with more energy for the next patches.

Gameplay Changes

Removed the item drop on the Forgotten Spearman, which previously dropped level 49 gear.
Reduced the drop rate of HP and Magic boosts in Chapter 7.
The card system is back and fully operational.
Balance Changes
Minor adjustment to the final bosses.
Buffs
The archer's attack "Mowlalk Shot" has been improved. It now goes from:
a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2 → a.atk * 5 - b.def * 2.

Nerfs

Sword Dance nerf: a.atk * 6 - b.def * 2 → a.atk * 5 - b.def * 2, and the speed is reduced by 10. The TP cost increases from 30 to 35.
Nerf to "Magic Missile": 200 + a.mat * 2 - b.mdf * 2 → 110 + a.mat * 2 - b.mdf * 2.
Nerf to the "Volent Blow" skill: the number of repetitions goes from 5 to 4, its PT gain drops from 4 to 1, and its speed is reduced from 0 to -20.
Nerf to the Mage's "Battle Hit": a.atk * 5 - b.def * 2 → a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2 / Nerf to speed: from 0 to -10.

Bug Fixes

In the town in Chapter 6, the image for the armor shop has been fixed.
The teleportation to the shop has been corrected to appear in the correct position in front.
Fixed the door bug in Chapter 7.
Increased the drop rate of the Blue Stone in Chapter 1.

notes.title: patch 10.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today is a big day: we are officially launching patch 10.0, marking a new milestone for our game!

First, I’m excited to announce that from now on, you’ll receive a monthly update on the monster redesigns. In addition, the Darkness Tiers will progressively open, with new levels added in each update. While I can’t guarantee the exact number of new tiers each time, I can assure you that we’re picking up the pace! You’ll notice this right away, as the first monster has already been redesigned with my own artwork. We are slowly saying goodbye to the RPG Maker monsters and welcoming our own 100% custom-made creatures.

Here’s what you’ll find in this patch:

Gameplay Changes
The first part of patch 10 is now live on Orathos, along with the start of the monster redesign in the early chapters.

Balance Changes
• None for this patch.

Buffs
• The archer's attack, Mowlalk's Shot, has been buffed. It now also reduces magical armor.

Bug Fixes
• The bug in the new Herb Tower has been fixed.
• The bug in the first Labyrinth Tower has also been resolved.

Additional Notes
• Every month, old monsters will be redesigned, with a few extra levels added.
• The game continues its climb to the top!
• For any issues or bugs, feel free to reach out via email or Discord.

notes.title: Orathos patch 10.0 ?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After these two months of vacation, I’m back and ready to continue developing The World of Orathos. I’ve taken your feedback into account regarding the quality of the graphics, the overly long and repetitive labyrinths, as well as the frequent use of default RPG Maker assets, etc.

First, I’d like to thank the early supporters who purchased The World of Orathos. Rest assured that your support will be heavily reinvested into regular updates.

Patch 10.0 is coming next month (October 15th), and it will add an additional 4 hours of gameplay, bringing the total to at least 16 hours of content. My drawing classes are progressing, and slowly but surely, the monsters of Orathos will change to feature my own designs.

Many of you have seen me working on the Unite version, which is a 2.5D/3D version of The World of Orathos with much better graphics. I’m working on it in parallel, and here’s why.

Unfortunately, since Unite is being developed using Unity, a new software for me, it requires a learning curve. Additionally, when the Unite update is released, all of your current game progress will unfortunately be lost. This really saddens me because I know how much time some of you have spent solving the mysteries of the game, etc.

That’s why, when version 1 of Unite is released in beta, a temporary launcher will be deployed for download so you can test Unite and give us your feedback as soon as possible. The beta sign-ups are not open yet, but they will be soon, and of course, I’ll keep you informed.

Now, back to patch 10.

This patch requires a lot of creative work for the new monsters. I’m doing my best to keep progressing and provide you with as much content as possible. That’s why patch 10.0 will be split into five major parts:

10.0: "Memories" Update – Release on October 15, 2024
10.10: 25 new floors in the cave – Coming soon
10.20: 25 new floors in the cave – Coming soon
10.30: 25 new floors in the cave – Coming soon
10.40: 25 new floors in the cave – Coming soon
This brings the total to 100 floors, with new monsters, challenges, exclusive items, and more. I ask for a little patience, but know that after all the updates for patch 10 are complete, I will dive into telling the story of Grylas, the main villain, divided into three chapters. Once that’s done, the game will be finished. At that point, I’ll focus on the Unite version, which will be patch 14.

Thank you again for your support. Orathos is about to make great progress, and I will move faster this year. Count on me!

Ropana
